claim: Square-function coefficient commutator for variable-order dyadic reductions.
method: Independent Bony decomposition, exact input-frequency supports, moderate-weight Schur bounds, and sequence convolution. Corrected the smooth-field weight ratio to use max(j-m,0).
result: The dyadic commutator is bounded by the tame coefficient norm. It excludes the exact logarithmic differentiation term and does not itself prove a full perturbed high estimate.
computation: Analytic audit only; no certified number.
